about: Family-friendly sports jokes. Each has a setup (q) and punchline (a); screens reveal the punchline halfway through.

items.q: Why did the golfer bring two pairs of trousers?
items.a: In case he got a hole in one.

items.q: Why are fish never any good at tennis?
items.a: They don't like getting close to the net.

items.q: What runs all the way round a football pitch but never moves?
Why can't Cinderella play football?
items.a: She always runs away from the ball.
